a1
Two years later, Pharaoh dreamed that seven thin cows ate seven fat ones, and seven thin ears of grain ate seven full ones.
a2
No wise man in Egypt could explain them. Then the cupbearer remembered Joseph.
b1
Joseph was brought from prison to explain the dreams. Not I, he said. God will give Pharaoh an answer.
b2
Joseph said: seven years of plenty are coming, then seven of famine.
c1
He advised Pharaoh to store grain in the good years.
c2
Pharaoh asked: can we find anyone like him, with the spirit of God? Then he set Joseph over Egypt.
d1
Pharaoh gave Joseph his signet ring, fine linen, and a gold chain. Joseph was thirty years old.
d2
For seven years he stored grain. He named a son Ephraim: God has made me fruitful in the land of my affliction.
e1
Then the famine came, and all lands came to Egypt for grain.
h1
Joseph gave God the credit before the palace.
h2
He prepared in the good years. In the palace, he named his son in thanks.
h3
Thanks and preparation can live in the same heart.
h4
Today, thank God for one good thing, and prepare for a harder day.
i
What will you thank God for today?
